What does this record establish about maximum complete-rod mass difference within one engine for connecting_rod_set?

RESEARCH RECORD [M64-PREC-O001]:
Application: Porsche993 Type3 factory connecting rods; M64/60 only from the applicability threshold printed in the Type3 heading on booklet printedp51. Component: connecting_rod_set. The reviewed factual register records maximum complete-rod mass difference within one engine as 6 g. Evidence status: factory_document_verified. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Factory assembly matching rule, not a weighing result, a measured user-engine balance or proof of modified-engine load capacity. Earlier rod categories and their mass intervals remain unchanged.
